senses.gloss: m. (παράφερνον) that which a bride brings over and above her dower; also (v. מוֹהַר) the wife’s additional settlement above the usual one (תוספת כתובה).
units: Gen. R. s. 80 (ref. to Gen. XXIV, 12) מוהר פרנין מתן פ׳ mohar is the endowment, mattan the addition; Yalk. ib. 134 פרא פ׳ (combine).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65">Gen. R. s. 65</cite> <he>הבא לי מפ׳ שלי וכ׳</he> (not <he>נין …</he>) take it from my additional dower, for thus he has written in my contract &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 114:6">Yalk. ib. 114</cite> <he>מפורנין</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:8:3">Y. Keth. V, 30ᵇ</cite> <he>פרא פרנין</he>. Ib. VII, 31ᶜ top <he>הפדא פ׳</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 5:7:5">Y. Gitt. V, 47ᵇ</cite> <he>נכסים שהכניסה לו פרה פרנון</he> property which she brought him above the dower, opp. <he>בכתובתה</he> corresponding to the amount of her settlement.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 5:1:9">Y. Naz. V, 54ᵃ</cite> top <he>פרה פ׳</he>. Y. B. Bath. V, end, 17ᵈ; a. e.
